supported_scope: Linux x86-64, one dashboard/coordinator on a persistent volume; optional PostgreSQL/S3 remote workers

live_integration_suite.services: PostgreSQL 17, two workers, Moto S3 test service

checks: Production Gunicorn process starts as non-root with a read-only root filesystem
Native login, secure cookies, mandatory MFA enrollment and recovery codes
Persisted reconciliation, exception evidence, CSV and Excel exports
Volume persistence, encrypted authenticator storage and recovery-code login survive container restart
production_container.scope: Disposable localhost production-image smoke test; public DNS/TLS and organization OIDC are not exercised.

checks: Certificate chain and localhost identity verified with an isolated test CA
HTTPS reverse proxy reaches the production application
Production HSTS response header is present
https_proxy.scope: Local private CA; no browser warning bypass or machine trust-store modification. Public-domain ACME issuance requires the deployment domain.

checks: Encrypted recovery outbox delivered to the local SMTP sink
Captured one-use link reset only the disposable member
smtp_recovery.scope: Mailpit only; no external email was sent. Test member access revoked after the check.

additional_checks: Authentication endpoint size limits and chunk-upload compatibility passed
Configuration secrets and Docker password round trip passed
Pinned Linux dependencies and Python base digest
Prebuilt image archive exported and SHA-256 recorded
operator_inputs: Administrator credentials entered privately by configure
Optional identity provider, SMTP, alert destination and cloud IAM settings
scope_limits: Public-domain certificate issuance is checked on the target host by the startup helper
No multi-dashboard HA or organizational SLA claim
Actual production AWS Object Lock/IAM and organization OIDC need account-specific acceptance
